reports.title: Flywire Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Guidance
section: ”We delivered another quarter of disciplined execution during our highest-volume peak, exceeding guidance across revenue-less ancillary services, and Adjusted EBITDA while generating robust free cash flow and sustained GAAP profitability. With strong execution across all verticals, we are raising our full-year 2026 outlook across revenue growth and adjusted EBITDA margin expansion. We have been GAAP profitable before, but this quarter marked a step change in scale of our GAAP profitability. This is true even when adjusting for a one-time, non-cash tax benefit tied to the release of our U.S. valuation allowance." - said Flywire's CFO, Cosmin Pitigoi.

In setting our Q4 outlook, we have appropriately factored in prudent visa assumptions across the big 4 education markets and B2B payment trends. Based on information available as of November 3, 2026, Flywire anticipates the following results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year 2026*.

FX-Neutral Revenue Less Ancillary Services Growth | 25-27% YoY
Adjusted EBITDA Margin Growth | +300 to 360 bps YoY

FX-Neutral Revenue Less Ancillary Services Growth | 14-20% YoY
Adjusted EBITDA Margin Growth | 330-530 bps YoY
